entities.summary: Mikael Mats Robert Persson, better known by his stage name Mike Perry, is a Swedish DJ and music producer from Skövde. He is best known for his 2016 single "The Ocean" featuring vocals from Shy Martin, which peaked at number 1 on the Swedish Singles Chart. Other popular songs by Perry include "Inside the Lines", "Stay Young" and "Don't Hide". Mike Perry was a composers & musicians from Skövde (b. 1983-06-24, Skövde). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
